name: Matenrou
source:
Main character "D" is a man who accepts different requests. What kind of request is waiting for him today? There are three chapters with multiple endings possible as a result.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角“D”是一个接受不同要求的男人。今天等待着他的，是什么样的请求呢？因此，三章可能有多种结局。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
